name: VTuber Avatar
summary: A drawn anime-style character takes the place of the host. A face tracker moves the eyes, mouth and head in real time. Pastel panels, sparkle and cute rounded frames hold the scene.

philosophy.core_thesis: The host is a character: a tracked avatar gives a person a face that is safe, stable and designed, and the frame is dressed to match.
design_principles: Place the avatar at 40% to 55% of the frame height, centred or at one third of the width.
Track blinks, mouth shapes and head tilt at 30 fps or more, with a lag under 100ms.
Draw the avatar with flat colour, a 3px dark outline and 2 to 3 steps of cel shading.
Frame the scene with rounded panels of 24px radius and a 4px white edge.
Use a pastel gradient ground (for example #FFD6EC to #D6E4FF at 160°).
Add sparkle marks of 12px to 24px and soft stars at 3 to 6 points in the frame.
Show chat comments as speech bubbles of 16px radius with a 14px text size.

layout.grid_mechanics: A 1920x1080 frame with a free layout on a 24px grid: the avatar at one third, a bubble chat panel on the right and a name plate at the lower-left.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 20% to 30% of the frame is soft empty ground; the spacing scale is 8, 16, 24 and 48px.
layout.alignment_rules: The avatar sits at one third of the width; the name plate aligns bottom-left; chat bubbles stack at the right edge.
layout.container_geometry: Rounded panels of 24px radius, circle masks for portraits and pill buttons of 999px.

font_pairings.note: A rounded sans that also covers Japanese text.
A soft, round display face for the name plate.
A pop display face with a round Japanese text face.

hierarchy_rules: Use two weights: medium (500) and extra bold (800).
Set the character name in 32px with a 3px white outline.
Set chat text at 14px on a white bubble.

color.palette_structure: Pastel pink, sky blue and lavender with a deep plum text colour and a gold sparkle.
color.contrast_rules: Plum text on the lavender ground holds at least 12:1; pink and blue carry panels and edges, not long text.
color.surface_treatment: Soft 2-stop pastel gradients with a 2% sparkle layer; flat colour on avatars.
color.light_and_shadow: Flat cel light with one soft rim in white; a glow of 12px on stars; a 16px soft shadow under panels at 15% plum.

materiality.surface_simulation: A 2D drawing in cel colour with a thin outline, as in an anime frame, placed in a bright digital room.
materiality.border_rules: A 4px white edge on panels and a 3px plum outline on the avatar.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: Soft 16px shadows under panels; the ground may blur at 12px; no hard shadow.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Solid, rounded icons at 24px: heart, star, mic and sparkle; round terminals.
ornamentation_details.illustration: A drawn avatar with eyes, hair and an outfit, simple mascots, stars and ribbons in flat colour.

motion.transition_physics: The avatar blinks every 3s to 5s and sways by 2° over 2s; panels bounce in over 400ms with a small overshoot; sparkles pulse over 1.2s.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover lifts a panel by 4px and adds a pink glow of 12px; active state squashes it to 96%.

emotion.target_response: The viewer feels warm and playful, and accepts the character as a friend.

avoid_when: The brand needs a real human face.
The tone is formal, medical or legal.
The page needs a dense, data-heavy layout.

modifiers.how: Swap the pastel panels for dark cut-corner slots with neon edges and a LIVE tag.
Replace the avatar with a webcam window of 20% width and add outlined captions.
Round all shapes to blobs, remove the outlines and use flat pastel fills.

pack.why: A soft, solid family with round terminals suits the cute panels and the sparkle marks.

ground.why: The ground is a pastel sky of soft bubbles, the room of a virtual character.
